findings.evidence: `rg` shows `theorem windingNumber_eq_of_hasCauchyPVAt` at line 67 with no preceding attribute; the theorem rewrites `windingNumber γ a b z₀` to the normalized PV value.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `windingNumber_eq_of_hasCauchyPVAt` so a local `HasCauchyPVAt` witness normalizes `windingNumber` automatically.
findings.issue: `windingNumber_eq_of_hasCauchyPVAt` is the characteristic value lemma for `windingNumber`, but it has no `[simp]` annotation.

findings.evidence: `rg` shows `theorem isNullHomologous_iff` at line 80 with no attribute; its RHS is exactly `∀ w ∉ Ω, windingNumber γ a b w = 0`.
findings.fix: Annotate the iff lemma, e.g. `@[simp, grind] theorem isNullHomologous_iff ...`, so null-homology hypotheses reduce to the vanishing condition without manual unfolding.

summary: The exposed definitions have the right shape, but their characteristic lemmas are not registered with automation, so downstream users must manually rewrite the new API.
